Summary: `CursorPageParameter` (`src/main/java/io/spring/application/CursorPageParameter.java`) only bounds `limit` — clamping values above 1000 (line 34-35) and silently ignoring non-positive values by keeping the default of 20 (line 33-39) — with no rejection path, contrary to CLAUDE.md's "reject invalid input, don't sanitize" rule. The `cursor` field has **no validation at all**: `setCursor` (line 29-31) is a bare assignment with no null/format/type check, so a malformed or out-of-range cursor passes through unmodified to the downstream MyBatis read services, where it would surface as an unhandled type-conversion/SQL error (out-of-range) or simply an empty result page rather than a clean validation rejection.
